This is a classic AI generation artifact where the model mimics the texture of text without understanding orthography.
The skin has an overly smooth, airbrushed quality typical of AI portraits. There is slight bleeding/fusion between the hair strands and the background, lacking sharp definition.

The fingers wrapping around the can appear slightly distorted. The thumb position is awkward, and the finger joints lack clear anatomical definition, appearing somewhat fused or melted into the can's surface.
